title: Pool lane loses base-project identity for knowledge/render tools
wanted_capability: Every claimed lane should resolve project-scoped Blackbox state to the registered base repository while targeting durable file writes into the lane checkout.
missing_primitive: Lane-pool checkout to registered base-project identity mapping for all project-scoped Blackbox tools
fallback_used: Keep the correctly updated repo-owned `.bbox/knowledge/7276b5c6.json` in the lane branch and do not render generated provider files from the lane checkout.
evidence: bbox_learn update of existing project knowledge id 7276b5c6 reported project path changed from /Users/invidious/repos/transcript-search to /Users/invidious/lanes/bpool1/blackbox
bbox_render(dry_run=true, scope=project, provider=codex, project=/Users/invidious/lanes/bpool1/blackbox) proposed a 212-byte AGENTS.md containing only the PROJECT.md pointer
bbox_gap_update could not find gap-cd5edeee immediately after bbox_gap created that project-scoped file in the same lane checkout
suggested_owner: bbox-cage lane pool and Blackbox project resolution
notes: The lane-pool checkout behaves like a clone rather than a linked git worktree, so project-scoped knowledge/render paths do not reuse the base repo identity. This can silently erase rendered project conventions if an agent renders from the lane, and follow-up mutation tools cannot find lane-filed gaps.
